subject: Quick shuffle needed for Wednesday's session
text: Hi all, quick heads up because Wednesday's session has to move, and I want to keep everyone on the same page. I know this week is already packed, so I am sorry for the last-minute change. The room booking got pushed back by the facilities team, and the new slot is Friday at 2:30 p.m. That is not ideal, but it does give us a little breathing room after the morning reports. I can make Friday work if the rest of you can, though I know a couple of folks have standing pickups. If the Friday slot is a deal-breaker, please hit reply by this evening and tell me what is holding you up. I am not trying to force a bad fit; I just need to lock something down before the scheduling window closes. If we can land it, we will run the usual agenda and keep the chat short. Otherwise, we can split it into a ten-minute check-in and a longer catch-up later next week. Let me know by 6 p.m. at the latest. Thanks for rolling with this one; I appreciate the flexibility. If you are offsite, dial in by phone, and I will share a plain-language summary afterward so nothing slips. If someone can grab the notes today, I can track action items and follow-ups.
